description: Read the full JSON Schema of any OODS Foundry tool at the pinned version, as the package ships it: name is any of its tools, local-only ones included, and kind is input (the default) or output. Returns the schema, its file in the package, that file’s SHA-256 and its URL on this site. Use it before calling a tool over local stdio, or to learn what a tool returns: these hosted tools declare no output schema, and tools/list here shows narrower inputs than local stdio accepts.
name: tool_schema
title: Read Tool Schema
